method: lark-cli base +table-create (primary field only) + sequential single +field-create calls (18 fields, one API call per field, in template order) + +view-set-visible-fields to pin the default grid view to template order

diff_report.note_on_raw_field_list_order: The Bitable ListAppTableField API does not reliably return fields in creation order (confirmed independently by lark-cli +field-list returning divergent orders for the long-established 互联网科技岗 vs 互联网科技岗·续表1 tables, and by this build reordering select-type fields even when created one-at-a-time). The default grid view (vewUyqrlNl) visible_fields was explicitly set via +view-set-visible-fields to the exact 19-field template order and verified by readback; this is the order a user actually sees.
